values: 自身的最大生命值降低，以此为代价额外布置一个可以释放技能的幻象。主动使用时对周围敌人造成伤害，并为自身恢复生命值。

Passive. Phraesto sacrifices max HP to summon an Illusion who can cast all his skills.
Active. Phraesto deals damage to enemies nearby and recovers his HP for each enemy hit.

被动地，普鲁斯托的最大生命值降低12%，但玩家在备战时可以额外布置一个以假乱真的幻象。幻象继承普鲁斯托100%属性，且可以使用全部技能。当本体与幻象布阵在同一行时，双方将会获得30%减伤效果，持续至其中一方被击败。
主动使用时，对周围2格范围内的所有敌人造成200% + 20% ATK伤害，每命中一个敌人为自身恢复160% + 15% ATK生命值。

Passive. Phraesto sacrifices 12% of his max HP, summoning an identical Illusion during the preparation stage. This Illusion inherits 100% of Phraesto's stats and can cast all his skills. When both Phraesto and his Illusion are positioned in the same row, they each receive a 30% damage reduction effect, lasting until one of them is defeated.
Active. Phraesto deals 200% + 20% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles, recovering himself 160% + 15% ATK HP for each enemy hit.
主动使用时的伤害提高至240% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 240% + 20% ATK.
主动使用时的伤害提高至280% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 280% + 20% ATK.
主动使用时的伤害提高至320% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 320% + 20% ATK.
主动使用时的伤害提高至360% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 360% + 20% ATK.
战斗开始时，本体与幻象各自与身后友军签订契约。战斗中主动释放时，对面前的一名敌人造成三次伤害。

Phraesto and his Illusion each sign a permanent contract with different allied heroes positioned behind them at the start of every battle.
Active. Deals damage to a frontal enemy 3 times.

战斗开始时，本体和幻象各自对布阵在其身后一格的一名英雄签订永久契约，并扣除其6%当前生命值。本体将使契约者永久提升14%能量获取速度，幻象将使契约者永久提高14%伤害减免。契约的具体效果在战斗开始前不对敌人可见。
战斗中主动使用时，对面前的一名敌人进行三次攻击，前两击造成100% + 10% ATK伤害，第三击造成140% + 20% ATK伤害。

Phraesto and his Illusion each sign a permanent contract with different allied heroes placed 1 tile behind them when a battle starts, reducing the recipient's HP by 6%. Phraesto increases the recipient's Energy Recovery Speed by 14%, while the Illusion increases the recipient's DMG Reduction by 14%. The terms of each contract remain undetected by enemies before the battle starts.
Active. Phraesto launches 3 strikes against an enemy in front, dealing 100% + 10% ATK damage with the first 2 hits and 140% + 20% ATK damage with the 3rd hit.
战斗中主动使用时，本体会使契约者额外获得80点能量；幻象会使契约者获得180% ATK护盾，持续6秒。
Phraesto grants his recipient an extra 80 Energy. The Illusion grants the recipient a 180% ATK shield for 6s.
战斗中主动使用时，第三击的伤害提高至210% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of the 3rd hit to 210% + 20% ATK.
战斗中主动使用时，第三击的伤害提高至280% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of the 3rd hit to 280% + 20% ATK.
对一名敌人施加“禁忌蝎毒”，使其不断流失生命并降低属性。
Phraesto inflicts an enemy with Paralyzing Venom, making them lose HP constantly and reducing their stats.
用钩尾蛰刺面前的一名敌人，对其造成50% ATK伤害并施加“禁忌蝎毒”，持续6秒。受“禁忌蝎毒”影响的敌人降低30点急速和45点受愈，每秒流失2% + 0.4%最大生命值，并使“禁忌蝎毒”的施加者每秒恢复3%最大生命值。敌人每秒流失的生命值最高不超过普鲁斯托攻击力的40%。

Phraesto stings an enemy in front, dealing 50% ATK damage and inflicting them with Paralyzing Venom for 6s. Enemies afflicted with Paralyzing Venom have their Haste reduced by 30 and Vitality reduced by 45. They also lose 2% + 0.4% of their max HP per second, while restoring 3% of the caster's max HP per second. Enemy HP loss can't exceed 40% of Phraesto's ATK per second.
敌人每秒流失的生命值提高至2.5% + 0.4%最大生命值。
Increases the enemy's lost HP per second to 2.5% + 0.4% of their max HP.
“禁忌蝎毒”的施加者每秒恢复的最大生命值比例提高至4.5%。
Increases the max HP ratio restored per second for Paralyzing Venom's caster to 4.5%.
敌人每秒流失的生命值提高至3.3% + 0.4%最大生命值。
Increases the enemy's lost HP per second to 3.3% + 0.4% of their max HP.
本体和幻象的护甲与魔抗提高。当其中一方损失生命时，使另一方获得能量。
Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion. Whenever one of them loses HP, the other gains Energy.
本体和幻象的护甲与魔抗提高30%。每当其中一方累计损失10%最大生命值，将会使另一方获得15点能量。
Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 30%. Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 15 Energy.
本体和幻象的护甲与魔抗提高40%。每当其中一方累计损失10%最大生命值，将会使另一方获得20点能量。
Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 40%. Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 20 Energy.
本体和幻象的护甲与魔抗提高50%。每当其中一方累计损失10%最大生命值，将会使另一方获得25点能量。
Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 50%. Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 25 Energy.
幻象先于本体被击败时，对一名敌人造成伤害和眩晕效果。
Phraesto deals damage to an enemy and stuns them if the Illusion is defeated before he is.
若幻象先于本体被击败，则普鲁斯托会嘲弄累计对幻象造成伤害最高的敌人，对其造成500% ATK伤害和4.5秒眩晕。
Phraesto taunts the enemy who dealt the most damage if his Illusion is defeated before he is, dealing 500% ATK damage and stunning them for 4.5s.
本技能造成的伤害提高至600% ATK。
Increases the skill damage to 600% ATK.
本技能造成的伤害提高至700% ATK。
Increases the skill damage to 700% ATK.
若幻象先于本体被击败，则普鲁斯托会重新在自己身前召唤一个新的幻象，该幻象只继承本体60%最大生命值。本效果每场战斗最多触发1次。
Phraesto summons a new Illusion in front of himself if the previous Illusion is defeated before he is. The new Illusion inherits only 60% of Phraesto's max HP. Triggers once at most per battle.
本体与幻象布阵在同一行时，开局将会获得一个临时护盾。
When both Phraesto and his Illusion are positioned in the same row, they each receive a shield when a battle starts.
当本体与幻象布阵在同一行时，双方将会在战斗开始时获得相当于自身攻击力570%的护盾，持续12秒。
When both Phraesto and his Illusion are positioned in the same row, they each receive a shield equal to 570% of their ATK when a battle starts, lasting up to 12s.
